settings.preprocess: grayscale → resize long side to 3000px (LANCZOS, upscale ≤ 4.5x) → autocontrast(cutoff=1%) → Gray8 SoftwareBitmap
settings.row_merge: OCR lines overlapping vertically ≥ 0.5 of the smaller height are one row, words left→right
settings.word_join: engine words joined by one space (no re-spacing)
settings.circled_numbers: ring found at row start (or right after '제N조(…)') by HoughCircles + ink coverage {'min_r': 0.34, 'max_r': 0.62, 'hough_param2': 14, 'min_cover': 0.86, 'min_outer_white': 0.7, 'fill': (0.05, 0.8)}; garbled token ('0','㉣','@','(2)'…) removed; row-start circled jamo ㉠-㉭, lone '@'/'Ø'/'(7' also taken as a marker; digit inside ring read by OCR of ring interiors [(0.72, True, 48), (0.72, False, 64), (0.72, False, 48)] (vote); number = consistent read (1 or prev+1..prev+3) else prev+1; reset at each article row '제N조('
text_fixes: date dots: YYYY.MMDD / YYYY.MDD(unambiguous) / YYYYM.DD / YYYYMM.DD → YYYY.M.D
term fixes (ㅊ read as ㅈ etc.): 사재→사채, 종회→총회, 발행주식종수→발행주식총수, 액면종액→액면총액, 서을특별시→서울특별시, 대자대조표→대차대조표, 견우→경우, 개경→개정, 성약→청약, 절자→절차, 저분→처분, 저음→처음, 주식?수선택권→주식매수선택권
